messages.subject: GCC Regulatory & External Affairs Executive | ESG and Government Relations Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Gilbert Lennard Executive Search Team,

Your Dubai executive-search work across regulatory, governance and senior leadership appointments is relevant to my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where regulated growth requires institutional trust, government engagement and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
